title: Timi O's "25" is a record that will have you feeling on top of the world
htmlContent:
Timi O's "25" is a record that will have you feeling on top of the world. It packs an infinite amount of flex to be the motivation you need with his, being able to show his high class of skill and make music that will keep people going. His melodic approach shines in the music, and lets his presence be felt with writing that feels good to hear and that helps deliver the message to the fullest, as well as showcase his supreme talent.
